spec.description: The FastAPI service from every side, on OpenTelemetry metrics.

spec.title: RPS
spec.description: Requests per second now, and how it moved over the range.

spec.title: 5xx ratio
spec.description: Share of server errors now. Orange above 1% · red above 5%.

spec.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: P95 latency
spec.description: 95th percentile of request duration now. Orange above 500 ms · red above 1 s.

spec.title: Apdex
spec.description:
Application Performance Index over the selected range, 0–1: satisfied below the `Apdex: satisfied` threshold, tolerating up to `Apdex: tolerated` (count as half), frustrated above.

≥ 0.94 excellent · ≥ 0.7 acceptable · < 0.7 poor

spec.expr: (sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", le="$satisfied"}[$__range])) + sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", le="$tolerated"}[$__range]))) / 2 / sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Instances
spec.description: Hosts serving the application — a container in Compose, a pod in Kubernetes: the `host_name` of `target_info`. A dip is a restart.

spec.title: Workers
spec.description: Serving processes across all instances, each with its own `service.instance.id` — the `instance` label. A dip is a worker replaced.

spec.title: Routes
spec.description: Every route over the selected range: its traffic trend, requests, share of 4xx and 5xx, mean duration, P95 and P99. A mean far below P95 means a long tail. Click a route for its traces or its RPS, large and with values.

spec.expr: (sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (http_route, le) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) / sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (http_route, le) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

(sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"4.."}[$__range])) or sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Error budget left — 7 days
spec.description: Share of the 7-day budget of 5xx still unspent, for an availability target of `$slo`. At zero the target is missed.

spec.title: Burn rate — 1 h · 6 h
spec.description: How fast the 7-day error budget burns: 1× spends it exactly in 7 days. Red at 3.36× over 1 h (2% of the budget in an hour) and 1.4× over 6 h (5% in six hours).

spec.title: Fast enough — 7 days
spec.description: Share of requests over the last 7 days that finished within the `Apdex: satisfied` threshold — the latency objective beside the availability one, for the whole service like the budget.

spec.title: Availability — vs objective
spec.description: Share of requests not answered with 5xx, against the availability target `$slo`.

spec.title: Error budget left — over time
spec.description: The 7-day error budget still unspent at each moment: falling means burning.

spec.title: Burn rate — 5 m · 1 h · 6 h · 1 d
spec.description: How fast the budget burned over each window, through time: orange above 1×, red above 3.36×.

spec.title: RPS — total
spec.description: Requests per second across all routes; the grey dashed line is the same time yesterday.

spec.title: RPS — by route
spec.description: Requests per second per route.

spec.title: RPS — by status code
spec.description: 2xx green · 3xx blue · 4xx orange · 5xx red.

spec.title: RPS — errors by route and code
spec.description: Client and server errors of every route, one series per code: 4xx dashed orange, 5xx red. Click a series for the traces of that route with that code.

links.title: Traces of this route with this code

spec.title: 5xx ratio — by route
spec.description: Share of server errors per route over time. Orange above 1% · red above 5%.

spec.expr: (sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Exceptions — by type and route
spec.description: Unhandled exceptions from the access log, one series per type and route — the `route` field is the template the metrics call `http_route`.

spec.expr: sum by (error_type, route) (count_over_time({service_name="$service"} | json | error_type!="" | route=~"$route" [$__interval]))

links.title: Lines with this exception on this route

spec.title: Exceptions — messages
spec.description: Every exception over the selected range: its type, route and message, most frequent first. Click a message for its log lines and their stacks.

spec.expr: sum by (error_type, route, error_message) (count_over_time({service_name="$service"} | json | error_type!="" | route=~"$route" [$__range]))

spec.title: Latency — P50 · P95 · P99
spec.description: Request duration percentiles across all routes; the grey dashed line is P95 yesterday.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval] offset 1d)))

spec.title: Latency — distribution
spec.description: How many requests finished in each duration bucket over time: the darker the cell, the more requests. The tail shows above the P95 line it summarises.

spec.title: P95 latency — by route, with exemplars
spec.description: TraceQL metrics from Tempo: every dot is an exemplar — a real request; click it to open its trace. Computed from the spans, so it can differ a little from the histogram percentiles beside it.

spec.title: Bytes per second — received · sent
spec.description: Request and response bodies. Received counts only requests with a body and a `Content-Length` header.

spec.title: Request size P95 — by route
spec.description: Only requests with a body are measured: here, `POST /api/posts`.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (http_request_method, http_route, le) (rate(http_server_request_body_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (http_request_method, http_route, le) (rate(http_server_response_body_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Request share — by worker
spec.description: Each worker's share of the requests. The dashed line is an even split: a worker far from it is starved or overloaded.

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: P95 latency — by worker
spec.description: 95th percentile of request duration per worker: one worker slower than the rest is hidden in the total.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (instance, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: In flight — by worker
spec.description: Requests being handled right now, stacked by worker: the top is the total, expected ≈ RPS × mean duration (Little's law). The OpenTelemetry gauge has no route label.

spec.title: CPU — by worker, one core is 100%
spec.description: CPU time per second of each worker. The GIL holds a Python worker to about one core: orange from 80%, red at 100% — saturated however idle the host is.

spec.title: Involuntary context switches — by worker
spec.description: How often the kernel takes the CPU away from a worker mid-work. A rise means workers compete for the CPU.

spec.title: Worker starts — per minute
spec.description: Workers that appeared in each minute: a deploy, a crash or a recycle. A steady trickle with no deploy behind it is a worker dying.

spec.expr: count(count by (instance) (process_thread_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+"}) unless count by (instance) (process_thread_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+"} offset 1m))

spec.title: Workers replaced — over the range
spec.description: Workers seen over the range minus the ones that reported in the last minute: each is a crash, a recycle, or a container or pod replaced.

spec.title: Memory — by worker
spec.description: Resident memory of each worker process. A line that only climbs is a leak.

spec.title: Threads — by worker
spec.description: Threads of each worker: the event loop, the exporters, gRPC and the profiler.

spec.title: Open file descriptors — by worker
spec.description: Sockets and files each worker holds open.

spec.title: GC collections — by generation
spec.description: CPython's garbage collector runs per second, all workers together.

spec.title: CPU profile — flame graph
spec.description: `count primes` from /api/cpu and /api/report is the widest frame here.

spec.title: Traces — recent
spec.description: Open a trace: from a span to its log lines, its profile and the metrics of its operation.

spec.title: Traces — slow and failed
spec.description: Slower than the `Slow trace` threshold, or failed.

spec.title: Log lines — stream
spec.description: Expand a line: `trace_id` leads to the trace, `request_id` to every line of the request.

spec.title: RPS
spec.description: Запросов в секунду сейчас и как это менялось за выбранный период.

spec.title: Доля 5xx
spec.description: Доля серверных ошибок сейчас. Оранжевый выше 1% · красный выше 5%.

spec.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Задержка P95
spec.description: 95-й перцентиль длительности запроса сейчас. Оранжевый выше 500 мс · красный выше 1 с.

spec.title: Apdex
spec.description:
Индекс производительности приложения за выбранный период, 0–1: довольные — быстрее порога `Apdex: норма`, терпящие — до `Apdex: терпимо` (считаются за половину), недовольные — дольше.

≥ 0.94 отлично · ≥ 0.7 приемлемо · < 0.7 плохо

spec.expr: (sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", le="$satisfied"}[$__range])) + sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", le="$tolerated"}[$__range]))) / 2 / sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Инстансы
spec.description: Хосты, на которых работает приложение — контейнер в Compose, под в Kubernetes: `host_name` из `target_info`. Провал — это перезапуск.

spec.title: Воркеры
spec.description: Обслуживающие процессы во всех инстансах, у каждого свой `service.instance.id` — метка `instance`. Провал — это замена воркера.

spec.title: Маршруты
spec.description: Каждый маршрут за выбранный период: динамика трафика, число запросов, доли 4xx и 5xx, средняя длительность, P95 и P99. Среднее сильно ниже P95 — значит, длинный хвост. Нажмите на маршрут, чтобы открыть его трейсы или его RPS — крупно и со значениями.

spec.expr: (sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (http_route, le) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) / sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (http_route, le) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

(sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"4.."}[$__range])) or sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Остаток бюджета ошибок — 7 дней
spec.description: Доля семидневного бюджета на 5xx, которая ещё не потрачена, при цели доступности `$slo`. На нуле цель не выполнена.

spec.title: Скорость сжигания — 1 ч · 6 ч
spec.description: Как быстро сгорает семидневный бюджет ошибок: при 1× он уходит ровно за 7 дней. Красный при 3.36× за 1 ч (2% бюджета за час) и 1.4× за 6 ч (5% за шесть часов).

spec.title: Достаточно быстрые — 7 дней
spec.description: Доля запросов за последние 7 дней, уложившихся в порог `Apdex: норма`, — цель по задержке рядом с целью по доступности, для всего сервиса, как и бюджет.

spec.title: Доступность — относительно цели
spec.description: Доля запросов, на которые не ответили 5xx, в сравнении с целью доступности `$slo`.

spec.title: Остаток бюджета ошибок — во времени
spec.description: Сколько семидневного бюджета ошибок не потрачено в каждый момент: снижение — значит, бюджет сгорает.

spec.title: Скорость сжигания — 5 мин · 1 ч · 6 ч · 1 д
spec.description: Как быстро сгорал бюджет в каждом окне, во времени: оранжевый выше 1×, красный выше 3.36×.

spec.title: RPS — всего
spec.description: Запросов в секунду по всем маршрутам; серый пунктир — то же время вчера.

spec.title: RPS — по маршрутам
spec.description: Запросов в секунду на каждый маршрут.

spec.title: RPS — по кодам ответа
spec.description: 2xx зелёный · 3xx синий · 4xx оранжевый · 5xx красный.

spec.title: RPS — ошибки по маршрутам и кодам
spec.description: Ошибки клиента и сервера на каждом маршруте, по серии на код: 4xx — оранжевый пунктир, 5xx — красный. Нажмите на серию, чтобы открыть трейсы этого маршрута с этим кодом.

links.title: Трейсы этого маршрута с этим кодом

spec.title: Доля 5xx — по маршрутам
spec.description: Доля серверных ошибок на каждом маршруте во времени. Оранжевый выше 1% · красный выше 5%.

spec.expr: (sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Исключения — по типам и маршрутам
spec.description: Необработанные исключения из журнала запросов, по серии на пару «тип · маршрут»; поле `route` — тот же шаблон, что в метриках называется `http_route`.

spec.expr: sum by (error_type, route) (count_over_time({service_name="$service"} | json | error_type!="" | route=~"$route" [$__interval]))

links.title: Строки лога с этим исключением на этом маршруте

spec.title: Исключения — сообщения
spec.description: Все исключения за выбранный период: тип, маршрут и сообщение, сначала самые частые. Нажмите на сообщение, чтобы открыть строки лога со стеком.

spec.expr: sum by (error_type, route, error_message) (count_over_time({service_name="$service"} | json | error_type!="" | route=~"$route" [$__range]))

spec.title: Задержка — P50 · P95 · P99
spec.description: Перцентили длительности запросов по всем маршрутам; серый пунктир — P95 вчера.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval] offset 1d)))

spec.title: Задержка — распределение
spec.description: Сколько запросов завершилось в каждом интервале длительности во времени: чем темнее ячейка, тем больше запросов. Хвост виден выше линии P95, которая его обобщает.

spec.title: Задержка P95 — по маршрутам, с экземплярами
spec.description: Метрики TraceQL из Tempo: каждая точка — экземпляр, то есть настоящий запрос; нажмите на неё, чтобы открыть его трейс. Считается по спанам, поэтому может немного расходиться с перцентилями гистограммы рядом.

spec.title: Байт в секунду — получено · отправлено
spec.description: Тела запросов и ответов. В «получено» считаются только запросы с телом и заголовком `Content-Length`.

spec.title: Размер запроса P95 — по маршрутам
spec.description: Измеряются только запросы с телом: здесь это `POST /api/posts`.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (http_request_method, http_route, le) (rate(http_server_request_body_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (http_request_method, http_route, le) (rate(http_server_response_body_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Доля запросов — по воркерам
spec.description: Доля запросов каждого воркера. Пунктир — равное деление: воркер далеко от него недогружен или перегружен.

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Задержка P95 — по воркерам
spec.description: 95-й перцентиль длительности запроса на каждом воркере: один воркер медленнее остальных не виден в общей цифре.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (instance, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: В обработке — по воркерам
spec.description: Запросы, которые обрабатываются прямо сейчас, стопкой по воркерам: верх стопки — общее число, ожидаемо ≈ RPS × средняя длительность (закон Литтла). У этого gauge в OpenTelemetry нет метки маршрута.

spec.title: CPU — по воркерам, одно ядро это 100%
spec.description: Время CPU за секунду у каждого воркера. GIL ограничивает воркер на Python примерно одним ядром: оранжевый от 80%, красный на 100% — воркер загружен полностью, как бы ни простаивал хост.

spec.title: Принудительные переключения контекста — по воркерам
spec.description: Как часто ядро ОС отбирает CPU у воркера посреди работы. Рост означает, что воркеры борются за CPU.

spec.title: Старты воркеров — в минуту
spec.description: Воркеры, появившиеся за каждую минуту: выкатка, падение или плановая замена. Постоянный поток стартов без выкатки — значит, воркеры умирают.

spec.expr: count(count by (instance) (process_thread_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+"}) unless count by (instance) (process_thread_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+"} offset 1m))

spec.title: Заменено воркеров — за период
spec.description: Воркеры, замеченные за период, минус те, что присылали метрики за последнюю минуту: каждый — это падение, плановая замена или замена контейнера или пода.

spec.title: Память — по воркерам
spec.description: Резидентная память каждого процесса-воркера. Линия, которая только растёт, — это утечка.

spec.title: Потоки — по воркерам
spec.description: Потоки каждого воркера: цикл событий, экспортёры, gRPC и профилировщик.

spec.title: Открытые файловые дескрипторы — по воркерам
spec.description: Сокеты и файлы, которые держит открытыми каждый воркер.

spec.title: Сборки мусора — по поколениям
spec.description: Запуски сборщика мусора CPython в секунду, по всем воркерам вместе.

spec.title: Профиль CPU — флейм-граф
spec.description: Самый широкий фрейм здесь — `count primes` из /api/cpu и /api/report.

spec.title: Трейсы — последние
spec.description: Откройте трейс: от спана можно перейти к его строкам лога, профилю и метрикам его операции.

spec.title: Трейсы — медленные и с ошибкой
spec.description: Медленнее порога `Медленный трейс` или завершились ошибкой.

spec.title: Строки лога — поток
spec.description: Раскройте строку: `trace_id` ведёт к трейсу, `request_id` — ко всем строкам этого запроса.

spec.title: RPS
spec.description: 当前每秒请求数，以及它在所选时间范围内的变化。

spec.title: 5xx 比例
spec.description: 当前服务端错误占比。高于 1% 为橙色 · 高于 5% 为红色。

spec.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: P95 延迟
spec.description: 当前请求耗时的第 95 百分位。高于 500 毫秒为橙色 · 高于 1 秒为红色。

spec.title: Apdex
spec.description:
所选时间范围内的应用性能指数，0–1：低于 `Apdex：满意` 阈值为满意，不超过 `Apdex：可容忍` 为可容忍（按一半计），更慢则为失望。

≥ 0.94 优秀 · ≥ 0.7 可接受 · < 0.7 差

spec.expr: (sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", le="$satisfied"}[$__range])) + sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", le="$tolerated"}[$__range]))) / 2 / sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

spec.title: 实例
spec.description: 运行应用的主机——在 Compose 中是容器，在 Kubernetes 中是 Pod：`target_info` 中的 `host_name`。数值下降表示发生了重启。

spec.title: 工作进程
spec.description: 所有实例中的服务进程，每个都有自己的 `service.instance.id`，即 `instance` 标签。数值下降表示有工作进程被替换。

spec.title: 路由
spec.description: 所选时间范围内的每条路由：流量趋势、请求数、4xx 和 5xx 占比、平均耗时、P95 和 P99。平均值远低于 P95 说明存在长尾。点击路由可查看其追踪，或放大查看其 RPS 及具体数值。

spec.expr: (sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (http_route, le) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) / sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (http_route, le) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])))

(sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"4.."}[$__range])) or sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

spec.title: 剩余错误预算 — 7 天
spec.description: 在可用性目标为 `$slo` 时，7 天 5xx 错误预算中尚未用掉的比例。降到零即未达成目标。

spec.title: 消耗速率 — 1 小时 · 6 小时
spec.description: 7 天错误预算的消耗速度：1× 表示恰好 7 天耗尽。1 小时窗口达到 3.36×（一小时耗掉 2% 预算）或 6 小时窗口达到 1.4×（六小时耗掉 5%）时为红色。

spec.title: 足够快 — 7 天
spec.description: 过去 7 天内在 `Apdex：满意` 阈值内完成的请求占比，即与可用性目标并列的延迟目标，和错误预算一样针对整个服务。

spec.title: 可用性 — 对照目标
spec.description: 未以 5xx 响应的请求占比，与可用性目标 `$slo` 对照。

spec.title: 剩余错误预算 — 随时间变化
spec.description: 每个时刻尚未用掉的 7 天错误预算：下降即表示正在消耗。

spec.title: 消耗速率 — 5 分钟 · 1 小时 · 6 小时 · 1 天
spec.description: 各窗口内预算随时间的消耗速度：高于 1× 为橙色，高于 3.36× 为红色。

spec.title: RPS — 总计
spec.description: 所有路由的每秒请求数；灰色虚线是昨天同一时间。

spec.title: RPS — 按路由
spec.description: 每条路由的每秒请求数。

spec.title: RPS — 按状态码
spec.description: 2xx 绿色 · 3xx 蓝色 · 4xx 橙色 · 5xx 红色。

spec.title: RPS — 按路由和状态码的错误
spec.description: 每条路由的客户端和服务端错误，每个状态码一条序列：4xx 为橙色虚线，5xx 为红色。点击序列查看该路由在该状态码下的追踪。

links.title: 该路由该状态码的追踪

spec.title: 5xx 比例 — 按路由
spec.description: 每条路由的服务端错误占比随时间变化。高于 1% 为橙色 · 高于 5% 为红色。

spec.expr: (sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: 异常 — 按类型和路由
spec.description: 来自访问日志的未处理异常，每个“类型 · 路由”组合一条序列；`route` 字段即指标中称为 `http_route` 的路由模板。

spec.expr: sum by (error_type, route) (count_over_time({service_name="$service"} | json | error_type!="" | route=~"$route" [$__interval]))

links.title: 该路由上包含此异常的日志行

spec.title: 异常 — 消息
spec.description: 所选时间范围内的全部异常：类型、路由和消息，最常见的排在前面。点击消息查看对应日志行及其堆栈。

spec.expr: sum by (error_type, route, error_message) (count_over_time({service_name="$service"} | json | error_type!="" | route=~"$route" [$__range]))

spec.title: 延迟 — P50 · P95 · P99
spec.description: 所有路由的请求耗时百分位；灰色虚线是昨天的 P95。

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval] offset 1d)))

spec.title: 延迟 — 分布
spec.description: 随时间推移，每个耗时区间内完成了多少请求：格子颜色越深，请求越多。长尾出现在概括它的 P95 线之上。

spec.title: P95 延迟 — 按路由，含示例
spec.description: 来自 Tempo 的 TraceQL 指标：每个点都是一个示例，即一次真实请求；点击即可打开它的追踪。它由 span 计算得出，因此可能与旁边基于直方图的百分位略有差异。

spec.title: 每秒字节数 — 已接收 · 已发送
spec.description: 请求体和响应体。“已接收”只统计带请求体且有 `Content-Length` 头的请求。

spec.title: 请求大小 P95 — 按路由
spec.description: 只统计带请求体的请求：这里是 `POST /api/posts`。

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (http_request_method, http_route, le) (rate(http_server_request_body_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: 响应大小 P95 — 按路由

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (http_request_method, http_route, le) (rate(http_server_response_body_size_bytes_bucket{job=~"$service", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: 请求占比 — 按工作进程
spec.description: 每个工作进程分到的请求占比。虚线表示平均分配：远离它的工作进程要么吃不饱，要么过载。

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: P95 延迟 — 按工作进程
spec.description: 每个工作进程请求耗时的第 95 百分位：某个工作进程比其他的慢，在总体数值里是看不出来的。

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (instance, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+", http_request_method=~"$method", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: 处理中 — 按工作进程
spec.description: 当前正在处理的请求，按工作进程堆叠：顶部即总数，预期 ≈ RPS × 平均耗时（利特尔法则）。OpenTelemetry 的这个 gauge 没有路由标签。

spec.title: CPU — 按工作进程，一个核为 100%
spec.description: 每个工作进程每秒占用的 CPU 时间。受 GIL 限制，一个 Python 工作进程大约只能用满一个核：80% 起为橙色，100% 为红色 — 无论主机多空闲，此时它都已饱和。

spec.title: 非自愿上下文切换 — 按工作进程
spec.description: 内核在工作进程执行中途收回 CPU 的频率。上升说明工作进程在争抢 CPU。

spec.title: 工作进程启动 — 每分钟
spec.description: 每分钟新出现的工作进程：一次发布、一次崩溃或一次回收。没有发布却持续出现启动，说明工作进程在不断死掉。

spec.expr: count(count by (instance) (process_thread_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+"}) unless count by (instance) (process_thread_count{job=~"$service", instance=~"(${host:regex})-[0-9]+"} offset 1m))

spec.title: 被替换的工作进程 — 所选时间范围内
spec.description: 所选时间范围内出现过的工作进程，减去最近一分钟内仍上报指标的：每一个都是一次崩溃、回收，或容器、Pod 被替换。

spec.title: 内存 — 按工作进程
spec.description: 每个工作进程的常驻内存。只升不降的曲线就是内存泄漏。

spec.title: 线程 — 按工作进程
spec.description: 每个工作进程的线程：事件循环、导出器、gRPC 和剖析器。

spec.title: 打开的文件描述符 — 按工作进程
spec.description: 每个工作进程保持打开的套接字和文件。

spec.title: 垃圾回收次数 — 按代
spec.description: CPython 垃圾回收器每秒运行次数，所有工作进程合计。

spec.title: CPU 剖析 — 火焰图
spec.description: 这里最宽的帧是来自 /api/cpu 和 /api/report 的 `count primes`。

spec.title: 追踪 — 最近
spec.description: 打开一条追踪：可以从 span 跳到它的日志行、剖析数据和所属操作的指标。

spec.title: 追踪 — 慢的和失败的
spec.description: 比 `慢追踪` 阈值更慢，或已失败。

spec.title: 日志行 — 日志流
spec.description: 展开一行：`trace_id` 指向追踪，`request_id` 指向该请求的所有日志行。

spec.title: FastAPI: traffic, latency, errors, traces, logs, profile

spec.name: routes
spec.label: Routes matching
spec.description: A regular expression: which routes the Route list offers. The page and static files are left out by default.

spec.name: host
spec.label: Host
spec.description: A container in Compose, a pod in Kubernetes: the workers panels show the hosts picked here.

spec.name: satisfied
spec.label: Apdex: satisfied
spec.description: Seconds; a bound of the duration histogram.

spec.name: tolerated
spec.label: Apdex: tolerated
spec.description: Seconds; a bound of the duration histogram.

spec.name: slow
spec.label: Slow trace
spec.description: A TraceQL duration: traces longer than this are listed as slow.
